text:
andrew: Heads up — I'm prototyping a dashboard panel that attributes cache savings back to routing buckets/quota owners. Want quick feedback on the heuristic before I wire telemetry.
maya: nice. quick q: are we attributing on request origin (route) or on tenant that paid for the model instance?
yuki: i'd prefer route-origin attribution initially. easier to reason about for teams that own features. plus routing decisions are visible in console.
chris: caveat: shared prefixes break that. example: system prompt cached once then reused across many routes => over-crediting the initial route.
andrew: exactly. current heuristic proposal: credit = cached_tokens_saved * weight(route) where weight(route) = 1 / active_routes_sharing_prefix. basically split evenly among routes that consumed the prefix in the window.
maya: splitting evenly seems fair. what window? 1h? 24h?
andrew: starting with 24h sliding window. we can experiment with 1h for latency-sensitive workloads.
liz: UX: show both "realized" and "amortized" savings. realized = tokens saved this time by this route; amortized shows how much each route is carrying after sharing split.
yuki: telemetry needs: per-request fields: model_sku, route_id, tenant_id, cache_hit(bool), cached_tokens_saved (int), prefix_hash. we also need to emit which backend served the request for fallback analysis.
chris: +1. also capture routing_policy tag (latency/cost/region). helps explain why some routes get fewer cache hits.
andrew: implementation note: compute attribution in the aggregation pipeline (beam/job) rather than per-request so we can join on prefix_hash and time window. sketch:
```
group_by(prefix_hash, window)
  -> collect(unique_routes)
  -> for each request with cache_hit: credit = cached_tokens_saved / len(unique_routes)
```
maya: does this work for streaming responses where cached tokens happen mid-stream?
andrew: streaming: we tag partial cache hits with the same prefix_hash and emit cached_tokens_saved per chunk. aggregation handles it.
liz: billing interaction: make sure cache credits don't push tenants above quota refunds / negative charges. Product wants credits as "savings" not as negative usage that reduces meter weirdly.
yuki: we should cap credited savings applied to billing to <= observed billed tokens for the tenant in window. otherwise weird negative invoices.
chris: rollout plan: canary the attribution in console only for 10% of customers (A/B), collect metrics: per-tenant variance vs baseline, UI confusion tickets, and any anomalies in billing pipeline.
andrew: ops-bot: schedule canary job for next Tuesday 03:00 UTC for 10% sample and add a kill switch.
ops-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary_attrib_v1 -> sample=10% -> start=2025-04-01T03:00:00Z. Kill switch: /kill canary_attrib_v1
maya: one more UX ask: allow toggling attribution method in the UI (equal split vs request-weighted). teams will want to pick which aligns to their internal chargebacks.
andrew: good call. I'll add a toggle and a brief explainer tooltip. thanks all, I'll push the prototype and link the dashboard once the job is wired. :rocket:
